name: formspec_cloud_saas_v1
title: Formspec Cloud SaaS V1 product needs
description: Imported from the approved SAAS-V1 product plan. The source is a product decision document rather than Rulespec or Observation evidence, so every record declares team-consensus instead of pretending the Markdown is normative or empirical grounding.

journeys.title: Customer administrator
journeys.description: A person setting up and operating a hosted forms and signature workspace.

journeys.title: Form author
journeys.description: A person preparing, publishing, and monitoring a hosted form.

journeys.title: Respondent
journeys.description: A person completing a public form and relying on proof that it was received.

journeys.title: Integrator
journeys.description: A developer connecting another system to forms, events, and response data.

needs.title: Get into the right workspace safely

statement.who: a person responsible for a customer workspace
statement.want: to sign up, sign in, recover access, and know which workspace I am using
statement.why: if access is confusing or fragile, I cannot safely operate the forms my organization depends on
statement.done: I can enter or recover my account and arrive in the intended workspace without staff editing data for me

statement.who: a person starting Formspec Cloud for an organization
statement.want: to create the organization, workspace, environments, teammates, and basic roles
statement.why: manual setup makes every new customer wait for engineering and makes ownership unclear
statement.done: I can finish setup myself and see the organization, workspace, environment, and invited teammates

statement.who: a person responsible for collecting information
statement.want: to import or create a form, preview it, publish a version, and share its hosted address
statement.why: a form that cannot move from authoring to a stable public address cannot collect real responses
statement.done: I can open the published form from its shared address and identify which version people will complete

needs.title: Complete a form and keep proof

statement.who: a person completing a hosted form
statement.want: to enter my information, review it, submit it, and keep a receipt
statement.why: without a clear completion path and durable proof, I cannot know whether the organization received what I sent
statement.done: after review and submission, I can see and retain a receipt with a verifiable proof status

statement.who: a person responsible for the information a form collects
statement.want: to see received responses and export them in common formats
statement.why: responses that stay trapped in a submission endpoint cannot support the work the form was created for
statement.done: I can find recent responses, understand their status, and export CSV or JSON

statement.who: a person who needs someone else to sign a document
statement.want: to send a basic signature request, follow its status, remind the signer, and obtain the certificate
statement.why: a signing step without status and proof leaves both sides unsure whether the agreement is complete
statement.done: I can see the envelope reach completion and retrieve a certificate whose proof can be checked

statement.who: a developer integrating a customer system with Formspec Cloud
statement.want: an API key, useful API documentation, a test environment, and one observable webhook
statement.why: bespoke setup and invisible deliveries make even a small integration expensive to build and impossible to support
statement.done: I can make an authenticated test request and see whether a webhook delivery succeeded

statement.who: a person accountable for a customer's subscription
statement.want: to see the current plan, usage, limits, billing status, and available features
statement.why: hidden limits and surprise restrictions make it impossible to plan work or explain a blocked capability
statement.done: I can compare current usage with the plan limit and tell whether billing and entitlements are current

needs.title: Get help and check service trust

statement.who: a person accountable for using Formspec Cloud
statement.want: to see service health, contact support, review incidents, and access current trust documents
statement.why: when service posture is hidden, I cannot respond to an outage or decide whether the service is acceptable for my organization
statement.done: I can distinguish service states, reach support, and open the security and subprocessor information I need

statement.who: anyone deciding whether to rely on a visible capability
statement.want: every feature to say whether it is live, assisted, preview, or unavailable
statement.why: a dead button or an unstated staff dependency makes the product promise false at the moment I rely on it
statement.done: every visible capability has one clear state and no unavailable capability behaves like a working one
